fix(tui2): constrain transcript mouse selection bounds

Ignore mouse events outside the transcript region so composer/footer interactions do not start or mutate transcript selection state.

A left-click outside the transcript also cancels any active selection. Selection changes schedule a redraw because mouse events don't inherently trigger a frame.
